question: Relativity table a customer can read
Hybrid GLM: yes: plus a small 2-way table per interaction
XGBoost: no: needs SHAP or partial-dependence summaries (Milestone 12)

question: Rating worksheet (show the arithmetic)
XGBoost: no exact worksheet; only approximate attributions

question: Effect directions guaranteed
GLM champion: yes: one sign per factor, inspectable
Hybrid GLM: yes, after checking the interaction cells
XGBoost: only where monotone constraints are set (Tweedie only)

question: Same effect everywhere
XGBoost: no: an effect can differ in every cell

question: Regulator / rate filing
XGBoost: possible but needs model governance docs, SHAP, stability evidence

question: Stable when retrained
XGBoost: moves with the random seed, too
